scope: initial actual authoring findings and offline support, production improvements follow extraction analysis

items.title: Structural/context variants
items.validationRequired: Fail number/name/synonym/order-only controls; pass meaningful condition/data/question organization or natural new situation while preserving core steps; fluency, method and presentation reviews independent
items.authoredExamples: New actual manual candidate examples and reproducible asset/code calculations, not generalized generator implementation

items.title: School/context substitution
items.validationRequired: Search stem/choices/subparts/table/figure/solution for real-name residue; one mapping per school per question; compare names affecting numeric/choice conditions

items.title: Independent twin solve gate
items.validationRequired: No original-answer oracle; all types solved; mutate stem/spec/asset/choice/score and reject old reports; independent computations, every step and uniqueness checked
items.actuallyImplemented: Separate blind solve, answer exposure only after hash binding; changed solves/author-self-review fail closed

items.title: Parameter constraints
items.validationRequired: Enumerate boundary parameters and at least 100 deterministic seeds per changed rule; separate solver checks denominator/domain/discriminant/positivity/integer counts/triangle inequalities and required solution cardinality

items.title: Choice quality
items.validationRequired: Recompute all options; algebraic-equivalent duplicate controls, one required correct answer/set, faithful figure-choice mapping, balanced answer positions and plausible distractors

items.title: Solution and rubric quality
items.validationRequired: Require new nonempty complete explanations; check cases, units and conclusion; subpart/rubric scores sum to item/paper totals; render and independent step review

items.title: Difficulty/reading-burden preservation
items.validationRequired: After U27 gate, preserve core steps/target difficulty; no new reading or prerequisite burden; labeled review and no confidence-only assignment

items.title: Concept/type coverage
items.validationRequired: Compare every extracted concept/core method to registry/live families; register∪hold completeness, no key collisions, actual multi-seed invariants and held reason per missing type

items.title: Conditions, tables and multipart forms
items.validationRequired: Preserve subpart/option order, table headers/units/data totals and score; rebuild tables instead of source crops; parser/render parity and independent recalculation
items.actuallyImplemented: Local authored table/paragraph and graph-choice preview only; native product pipeline unmodified

items.title: Prompt/catalog capability sync
items.validationRequired: Prompt includes current v2/graph/elem keys; representative geometry/function/stat/solid specs render; catalog generated from engine, unknown keys still reject

items.title: Figure mathematical bindings
items.validationRequired: Bind each length/angle/coordinate/table count to target facts and units; negative right-angle/ratio/scatter cases; allow documented figure-only givens; prevent showing sought answers
items.actuallyImplemented: Actual generated scene/vector mathematical bindings saved for q10/q19; independent asset review required

items.title: Strict figure quality
items.validationRequired: Strict render no silent dimension loss; collision/cutoff/label checks, explicit unresolved labels and omissions; source-review false/timeout drafts remain held; actual print size inspection

items.title: Multi-figure ownership
items.validationRequired: Multiple stem/subpart/solution/choice artifacts; exact URL/dims/mm/index cardinality, no duplicate/missing choice binding, screen/print parity; geometry SVG supplied per role through reviewed representation

items.title: Imagegen assets/templates
items.validationRequired: Pin reviewed bytes/template/hash/anchors; reject pending/stale/missing assets; no runtime skill call; label transcript/school/name review, multiple parameter cases and print legibility
items.actuallyImplemented: Two actual built-in imagegen PNGs with prompt/provenance, frozen bytes, exact diagram composition; no runtime skill call

items.title: Provenance and metadata read chain
items.validationRequired: External-origin twin never workbook; null FK truthful; authored raster never scan; old textbook/engine labels unchanged; source+variant+review/figure fields survive serialization; high-engine origin considered if current data requires it

items.title: Filter/search completion
items.validationRequired: UI→request→where/join→stored value parity; source/twin/review/year/term/asset/concept queries with unknown values, mixed filters, total counts and page boundaries; measure before adding indexes

items.title: Snapshot-based classification
items.validationRequired: Parent snapshot hash/time required; real Unit/live family; no-match/ambiguous cases held; five Bumil proposals reevaluated; mocked Jev timeout/invalid output paths cannot approve

items.title: Twin IDs/digests/replay
items.validationRequired: Separate reference/twin/solution/metadata versions, ordered canonical representation, byte changes stale results, ID collisions and rerun idempotency; problemCode not forged
items.actuallyImplemented: New candidate/student/asset/package digests and immutable review versions, old approvals never reused

items.title: Diversity/deduplication
items.validationRequired: Same seed/template version reproducible; semantic near-copy controls, structural/context coverage, spec/asset-aware keys, honest shortfalls; valid same-answer twins allowed; format siblings kept/dropped together

items.title: Review/failure observability
items.validationRequired: Persist successful and failed generation/review evidence, model/prompt/template version, pending versus rejected, changed-conditions reset and bounded retries; no fallback to old answer/crop
items.actuallyImplemented: Per-question math/grade/hold reasons are collected independently; production outcomes still blocked

items.title: Safe authored-asset handling
items.validationRequired: Manifest/file hash validation, trusted MIME/dimensions, physical-path escape/overwrite controls, hostile SVG/label rejection and separate raster boundary; do not weaken engine image prohibition
items.actuallyImplemented: Physical worktree containment, no overwrite, bound PNG resources and explicit SVG resource restrictions in offline tool; production sanitizer pending

items.title: Permanent exclusion/lock guard
items.validationRequired: 81 holds + 1 permanent exclude = 82 unique original IDs; 2 patches are subsets; q19 excluded despite new twin UUID and baseline before=true; no writer/unlock hidden in dry-run

items.title: Generation scope/count/answers
items.validationRequired: Reject incomplete requested batch without silently counting it complete; require solutions; grade-aware constraints and approved image/template input; mocked responses preserve pending/failed states

items.title: Korean/math notation consistency
items.validationRequired: Correct particles/units, natural context vocabulary, no wordy-symbol or source-font residue, valid math delimiters; normalization cannot change an equation or create fake structural change; screen/print textual review

items.title: Algebra/geometry representation templates
items.validationRequired: Signed-variable→positive-length counterexample must fail; distinguish segment from length; prove relation/domain equivalence, positive lengths/areas, coordinates/units and same principle; all new prerequisites pass U27
items.authoredExamples: New actual manual candidate examples and reproducible asset/code calculations, not generalized generator implementation

items.title: Inverse input/condition/parameter generation
items.validationRequired: M-m=R checks m=M-R, R≥0, attained extrema; negative/zero/boundary cases, impossible range, multiple parameters, denominator zero and square-root sign; independently solve full admissible inverse set and student method
items.authoredExamples: New actual manual candidate examples and reproducible asset/code calculations, not generalized generator implementation

items.title: Highest-priority applied-curriculum gate
items.validationRequired: 2025 middle3 resolves to 2015; all stem/choice/figure/notation/answer/student-solution/prerequisite surfaces checked; no legitimate method→reject, unclear→hold; unverified codes null; Unit/family/template existence and school/AI confidence never auto-approve
items.actuallyImplemented: Staged middle3/2015/source2025+ metadata checks, forbidden-method scan plus mandatory independent seven-surface review; generalized native curriculum gating pending
